intent: Implement the complete privacy audit with contextual masking, typed local substitution, incremental restoration, content-free final-wire evidence, redacted-by-default diagnostics, truthful policy and memory readiness, and an offline privacy/intent/timing check.
acceptance: Preserve useful task wording while protecting all independently specified synthetic private values; retain negative controls and exact restoration.
Reject changed privacy authority, known-value reinsertion, malformed wire shapes and invalid owned markers without authorizing another tool or silently replaying partial output.
Keep request maps isolated, export diagnostic content only under the selected redacted or explicit forensic identity, and preserve private memory owner/deletion semantics.
Preserve concurrent shared-branch commits and reconcile actual main, release identities, current rules, reviews and final-head checks before merge.
Require actual main qualification, trusted signed publication and complete independent published package verification before reporting completion.
